rows.definition: AMD KFD GEM allocation flag bit marking a GPU memory object as pinned so the driver's TTM page allocator must not evict its pages under memory pressure.
rows.distinction: Driver-level pinning of one GEM allocation inside AMD's kernel-driver ABI - NOT any fak-owned eviction policy or counter (EvictLRU, EvictOne, IncrEvictions) that chooses victims in fak stores.

rows.definition: radixkv Stats counter of victims staged and detached by the ratio-capped bounded eviction plane (#3387, plan.go).
rows.distinction: Counts only the bounded ratio-capped plane - NOT the coarse Evictions total across all planes and not PageEvictions (page-aware leaf evictions).

rows.definition: Per-client l3server statistic giving the fraction of that client's cached tokens currently eligible for eviction.
rows.distinction: A readiness ratio over what MAY be evicted - NOT an eviction rate (ratio of eviction events to load operations) and not a counter of evictions performed.

rows.definition: Cumulative eviction-event counter shared by the compute hierarchical-memory stats block and the strix MALLCacheBudgetTracker line/block eviction accounting.
rows.distinction: A lifetime COUNT of eviction events - NOT EvictionRate (dimensionless ratio over weight loads) nor EvictionDuration (time held pending eviction).

rows.definition: Wall-clock duration recorded on a continuous-batcher slot or subagent schedule entry for the window its resident state sat pending eviction (invariantly 0 ms in UMA mode).
rows.distinction: A TIMING measurement of an eviction window - NOT a count of evictions (EvictionCount) or a pressure ratio (EvictionRate).

rows.definition: Dimensionless ratio of MALL cache line evictions over weight-load operations returned by MALLCacheBudgetTracker.EvictionRate().
rows.distinction: An observed pressure RATIO on Strix MALL - NOT the vacuum_eviction_rate_norm configuration knob of l3server and not a raw event count (EvictionCount).

rows.definition: Lifetime l3server shard counter of eviction attempts that failed to free an entry.
rows.distinction: Counts FAILED eviction attempts - NOT successful evictions (IncrEvictions) and not lease-protected skips (EvictionsLeaseSkip).

rows.definition: Lifetime l3server shard counter of entries evicted because the key namespace was under capacity pressure.
rows.distinction: Cause attribution = KEY pressure - NOT value pressure (EvictionsValuePressure), rebalance movement (EvictionsRebalance), or lease skips (EvictionsLeaseSkip).

rows.definition: Lifetime l3server shard counter of eviction candidates skipped because a live lease protected them.
rows.distinction: Skipped-due-to-lease outcomes - NOT evictions that executed (IncrEvictions) or failed (EvictionsFailed).

rows.definition: Lifetime l3server shard counter of entries evicted as part of shard rebalancing.
rows.distinction: Cause attribution = REBALANCE movement between shards - NOT pressure-driven evictions (EvictionsKeyPressure, EvictionsValuePressure).

rows.definition: Lifetime l3server shard counter of entries evicted because stored values were under capacity pressure.
rows.distinction: Cause attribution = VALUE pressure - NOT key pressure (EvictionsKeyPressure) or rebalance movement (EvictionsRebalance).

rows.definition: Recency-based reclaim method implemented on CUDADirectStorageMemorySlab, KVPageOffloader, and ctxmmu KVPool that evicts least-recently-used blocks or pages up to a target count.
rows.distinction: fak-owned LRU block/page reclaim on storage slabs, offloaded KV pages, and the ctxmmu pool - NOT the KVEvictLRU replay-policy enum label, not evictOldestLocked (bounded graph-cache helper), and not EvictOne (l3server policy op).

rows.definition: Unexported lock-held helper that evicts the oldest entry from small bounded in-process caches (GraphCachePolicy, PowerOfTwoGraphCache, responses continuation store, SpeculativeBranchCache, rate Limiter).
rows.distinction: Oldest-entry eviction under an already-held mutex inside small config/graph caches - NOT EvictLRU (slab/page/pool block reclaim with target counts) and not EvictOne (l3server SIEVE/WTinyLFU policy op).

rows.definition: Single-entry eviction operation on the l3server eviction.Policy interface, implemented by SIEVE and WTinyLFU and driven by shard admission when a shard is full.
rows.distinction: One forced entry drop through a named probabilistic/recency policy - NOT bulk recency reclaim (EvictLRU), not the physical KV-span plane (evict (KV cache)), not the informal Evictor role term, and not orphan-worktree eviction (EvictOptions).

rows.definition: Variadic options struct configuring wipinventory EvictOrphans/PurgeOrphans quarantine behavior for abandoned worktrees and WIP lanes.
rows.distinction: Configuration surface for WIP-orphan eviction tooling (cmd/fak sweep / wip-evict callers) - NOT cache or KV eviction (l3server/radixkv/strix) and not a CLI verb itself.

rows.definition: ShardMetrics method that increments the current-window and lifetime eviction counters after a successful l3server shard eviction.
rows.distinction: The increment seam for SUCCESSFUL evictions - NOT the cause-attributed sibling counters beside it (EvictionsKeyPressure, EvictionsValuePressure, EvictionsRebalance, EvictionsLeaseSkip, EvictionsFailed).

rows.definition: Wire string value of the nativeperf PhaseKVEvict constant marking KV-eviction work in trace phases and CPU-work burndown buckets.
rows.distinction: The observed LABEL in traces and metrics - NOT the Go constant PhaseKVEvict that carries it and not any eviction implementation (KVEvictor, EvictOne).

rows.definition: Gateway interface that executes physical eviction or pruning on the KV tier (with KVEvictorFunc adapter), wired into gateway server state and the direct-I/O loopback path.
rows.distinction: The gateway-side EXECUTION PORT for KV eviction - NOT the informal prose role term Evictor, not the kv_evict trace label, and not the cachemeta KVEvictionScope invalidation vocabulary.

rows.definition: radixkv Stats field recording how many candidate leaves the most recent eviction pass considered.
rows.distinction: Diagnostic of the LAST eviction event - NOT the lifetime Evictions/BoundedEvictions counters and not the victim's own statistics (LastEvictVictim* fields).

rows.definition: radixkv Stats field recording how many locked/pinned candidates the most recent eviction pass had to skip.
rows.distinction: Lock-skips observed in radixkv's last pass - NOT the l3server EvictionsLeaseSkip counter, which counts shard lease protections.

rows.definition: radixkv Stats field recording the cost score of the leaf chosen as victim by the most recent eviction.
rows.distinction: The recorded score OF THE CHOSEN VICTIM - NOT the KVEvictionCost scoring function that produces such scores.

rows.definition: radixkv Stats field recording the historical hit count of the leaf chosen as victim by the most recent eviction.
rows.distinction: Hit count OF THE CHOSEN VICTIM - NOT tree-wide hit counters and not the victim's token count (LastEvictVictimTokens).

rows.definition: radixkv Stats field recording the prefix length shared by the victim leaf chosen in the most recent eviction.
rows.distinction: Prefix-depth statistic of ONE victim - NOT the EvictPrefix token-path eviction operation itself.

rows.definition: radixkv Stats field recording the token count released by the victim leaf in the most recent eviction.
rows.distinction: Tokens freed by ONE victim - NOT the tree-wide Tokens stat and not the victim's hit count (LastEvictVictimHits).

rows.definition: strix MALL tiling/stream counter of MALL cache block evictions observed during weight streaming, which must remain 0 under temporal pinning.
rows.distinction: Hardware MALL cache-line evictions on Strix - NOT the generic hierarchical EvictionCount stat and not l3server shard eviction counters.

rows.definition: radixkv counter of page-aware leaf evictions performed, tracked alongside the global Evictions/CostEvictions totals in admin stats.
rows.distinction: PAGE-granular eviction count - NOT the bounded-plane BoundedEvictions counter and not the coarse Evictions total.

rows.definition: nativeperf Phase constant whose value is the kv_evict label, classifying KV-eviction work in trace phases and CPU-work burndown buckets.
rows.distinction: The Go CONSTANT naming the phase - NOT its wire label kv_evict and not an eviction implementation (KVEvictor, EvictOne).
